assumptions.statement: Official regulatory, property, heritage, road, rail, water, municipal, fire, emergency and engineering controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory, parcel, capacity, demolition, construction, emergency or implementation conclusion is made; official data requires complete recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Repository provisional polygons are used only as rough constraints for intake and internal geometry checks.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios have low confidence and cannot describe existing conditions or official controls.

assumptions.statement: A person can choose and revoke a task-scoped supporter without public diagnostic or kinship proof, subject to a genuinely person-controlled private safety option.
assumptions.impact: The pass cannot be treated as proxy, signature, identity, data access, guardianship or emergency authority.
assumptions.risk: The mechanism may reduce autonomy, expose a relationship, or protect a coercive person if private confirmation is not genuinely controlled by the person.
assumptions.validation: Co-design with disability, interpretation, caregiving and anti-coercion specialists before any field test.

assumptions.statement: Understandable declaration, revocation, private safety checks, AI-off equivalence and reunion require co-design with affected people and relevant professionals.
assumptions.impact: The concept cannot claim accessibility, valid choice, service equivalence, emergency safety, deletion or successful reunion before independent review.
